findings.issue: The live check and live-proof ADD firstName/lastName, but the real createHumanUser (src/keycloak/admin-port.ts:392-407) omits them. Verified live: a no-names UI account persists actor_type + gets the claim (the fix works), but ROPC hard-fails 'Account is not fully set up' and browser login hits an interactive VERIFY_PROFILE step. This is PRE-EXISTING (KC 25 default profile also declares firstName/lastName required:{roles:[user]} — confirmed on a components-stripped pre-fix realm), not introduced by this fix, and correctly scoped out by the builder in followups_out_of_scope. Consequence: the automated live check proves actor_type persistence in isolation, not real end-to-end product login of a UI-created account.
findings.suggestion: Prioritize the flagged follow-up: the 'Создать учётку' form should collect a display name OR createHumanUser should send firstName/lastName so UI accounts are login-complete without a VERIFY_PROFILE interstitial. Optionally add an e2e that browser-completes VERIFY_PROFILE.

findings.issue: On a non-2xx from PUT /users/profile the reconcile prints only [WARN] and continues (exit 0). A silently-failed reconcile on a persistent stand would leave actor_type unmanaged. Acceptable (DEV-only script; CI and fresh provisioning use --import-realm, not this script), but a loud fail on non-2xx would be more honest.
findings.suggestion: Consider exiting non-zero on a non-2xx response from PUT /users/profile.
